info.name: Cities
info.description:
## Cities

### Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api/v1`

### Authentication
Public list/get endpoints require no token. Admin mutators require `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}`.

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `base_url` | API base URL |
| `admin_access_token` | Admin JWT (auto-set on login) |

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin-only mutators for cities (create, update, delete).

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| nameEn | string | YES | English name, max 128 chars. Globally unique. |
| nameAr | string | YES | Arabic name, max 128 chars. Globally unique. |

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 409 | City name (en or ar) already exists |
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| nameEn | string | Optional | New English name. |
| nameAr | string | Optional | New Arabic name. |

### Notes
Omitted fields are left unchanged.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | City not found |
| 409 | City name (en or ar) already exists |
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| cityId | path param | YES | City ID. |

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | City not found |
| 409 | City is referenced by other rows (areas, users) and cannot be removed |
